subject: MAP: Hosting priority sprint and regional commitment
messages:
From: Laura Jenkins <l.jenkins@novacorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>, NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — hosting mode & regions (intro)

Hi Tessa — thanks for the quick call this morning. Per our discussion, the exec team wants a concise MAP that ties the hosting mode decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) to a go-live commitment by region. Key constraints from our side:
- Data residency: initial scope must be US-only; EU comes later in Q4.
- Procurement: we need a firm order form by 2025-09-15 to hit our fiscal targets.
- Security: SOC2 + a short list of clarifications on key management.

Can you and your team propose a 6-week evaluation sprint with milestone dates (POC, security sign-off, procurement handoff, go-live runway) and call out the blockers for Dedicated or Private paths? Attaching the draft internal RACI.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Jenkins
Head of AI Platform, NovaCorp
--- attachment: novacorp_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) ---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Jenkins <l.jenkins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — hosting mode & regions (intro)

Laura — appreciate the clarity. Draft proposal below for a tight 6-week evaluation sprint (US region first). High level: we run Hosted POC in parallel with a light Dedicated capacity sizing assessment; Private (on-prem) is treat-as-separate track requiring separate procurement and timelines (we'll flag 12+ week runway).

Week 1 (7/28) — Kickoff & baseline metrics
- Confirm sample workload, sequence lengths, concurrency targets.
- Access: temporary Hosted API key + minimal telemetry.

Week 2 (8/4) — Latency/cost baseline (Hosted)
- Run representative requests, token cost analysis, and latency p50/p95 for target SLAs.

Week 3 (8/11) — Dedicated sizing & smoke test
- Estimate GPU pool size and run a small Dedicated pool test (if agreeable to trial credits).

Week 4 (8/18) — Security Q&A & KMS alignment
- Answer NovaCorp security items; demonstrate key management integration for Hosted and Dedicated.

Week 5 (8/25) — Canary plan & rollback criteria
- Define canary percentage, routing policies, and fallback to lower-capacity model variants.

Week 6 (9/1) — Exec review & procurement readiness
- Deliver final recommendation (Hosted vs Dedicated for US go-live) and a procurement-ready order form draft to hit 9/15 EFM.

Blockers we want to call out now:
- If data residency must be EU for initial traffic, Hosted will require regional deployment lead time (~6–8 weeks) and Dedicated may be preferred.
- Private/on-prem: depends on network & HSM availability; estimate 12–16 weeks for procurement + installation.

I'll attach a one-page MAP and proposed playbook. Marcus and Neha will own performance and security checkpoints respectively. Thoughts?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
--- attachment: novacorp_map_playbook.pdf (one-pager) ---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Laura Jenkins <l.jenkins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — hosting mode & regions (intro)

Quick technical note from my side:
- For the Hosted baseline we'll instrument continuous batching and KV cache snapshots to show p95 improvements; expect 20–30% cost delta vs naive host runs.
- For Dedicated sizing I need sample QPS and peak burst patterns. If you can share the 2-week trace (anonymized) we can size GPUs and provide a cost estimate within 3 business days.

Also tagging the risk: if NovaCorp needs HSM-backed KMS for key custody, the Hosted + customer-managed keys path is doable but requires legal/KMS onboarding (2–3 weeks). Private requires on-site HSM or FIPS module to be validated.

-Marcus

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Jenkins <l.jenkins@novacorp.com>, NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — hosting mode & regions (intro)

Thanks, Tessa and Marcus — useful structure. One ask from Architecture:
- Please include an explicit data-flow diagram for Hosted vs Dedicated (how logs/telemetry/KV snapshots are stored and who has access).
- For Dedicated, we need an option where data never leaves our VPC. Can you show the minimal network changes required and a preliminary security acceptance checklist?

Procurement note: we need a draft SOW and an approximate TCO to evaluate against our internal procurement thresholds. If you can share the Dedicated sizing estimate (ballpark) by 8/11, procurement can draft the order form to be internally approved by 9/10.

Priya Shah
Sr. Solutions Architect, NovaCorp

Priya — attaching the security items response and a short KMS whitepaper. Key highlights:
- Hosted: we support customer-managed KMS via Cloud KMS/HSM integrations; keys can be rotated by NovaCorp and logs segregated per tenant.
- Dedicated: full network isolation, optional private peering, and we can enable host-level encryption to meet your compliance needs.
- Private/on-prem: we provide an install pack but do not ship HSM hardware — procurement to source HSM or use customer-provided.

Next steps from security: please confirm which evidence items (encryption config, SOC2 artifact subset) procurement requires for the 9/10 approval target.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Jenkins <l.jenkins@novacorp.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — hosting mode & regions (intro)

Team — this looks good and aligns with our timelines. Quick decisions from NovaCorp execs:
- US go-live target: prioritize Hosted with Dedicated reserve if the p95 latency or cost delta exceeds our threshold.
- EU: postpone regional rollout to Q4 and re-evaluate after initial US metrics.
- Procurement wants a draft order form by 2025-08-25 and final sign-off by 2025-09-15.

Next asks for Redwood:
1) Marcus — please send the Dedicated sizing ballpark by 2025-08-11.
2) Neha — confirm evidence package items procurement needs by 2025-08-04.
3) Tessa/Marissa — produce the one-page MAP and a short decision rubric for Hosted vs Dedicated (cost threshold, latency threshold, data-residency triggers) by 2025-08-04.

If we can get those in the next two weeks, procurement will initiate the internal order flow. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Laura
